director_agenda.reopen_condition: Next campaign with an open COMMODITY_FUTURES/PHYSICAL_INVENTORY_FLOW slot; data-foundation certifies @CUWS with an explicit availability rule (LME publication timing, first release vs revised, total vs cancelled-warrant stocks); a frozen expression whose sign is fixed by storage theory (principle e) gets a pre-return G1/G4 ruling; the burden carries the 6 R99 trials of the slot.

Daily data gives more observations than the weekly/monthly series that were measured. Prior is tempered: all 6 measured R99 inventory expressions failed (C01/C05 cost-killed, C03/C04/C22 gross-negative, C02 lockbox gross -3.86%/yr). The expression must be chosen on mechanism, not by steering away from the measured failures. Warehouse-financing distortions of LME stocks are director reasoning and must be addressed in G4.
